title: Shareshian–Wachs elementary positivity

result.label: Shareshian–Wachs elementary positivity
result.statement: Resolves the elementary-positivity part of the Shareshian–Wachs conjecture: the chromatic quasisymmetric function of every natural unit interval graph has elementary-basis coefficients in N[q]. The coefficients count explicitly described permutations, giving a combinatorial explanation of positivity.
